title: Remote Gate Target Architecture
summary: Decision Dossier for replacing the fast but out-of-band SSH gate bridge with a first-class Tranche 0 execution contract. It compares claimable gate steps, the Review Plane, and capability-only dispatch; recommends a bounded GateAttempt protocol with capability-based admission; and defines the implementation-to-AGT-2262 teardown chain. [Curation 2026-08-18 (AGT-2671): DONE CHECK - design not yet approved by operator sight review and zero implementation of this target model exists (re-verified against develop 2026-08-24: the only Gate* types in the backend are the unrelated build-test gate's MachineGateLease in BuildTestGateRunner.cs and BuildTestGateSubject in ReviewDecisionOrchestrator.cs; no remote-gate GateSubject/GateAttempt/GateLease entity exists). AGT-2262 stays parked per its own eight-item cutover acceptance list. Stays active. DOC TRANSFER - GateSubject/GateAttempt/GateLease target model extracted to docs/concepts/platform-architecture/remote-gate.md.]

implementationTasks.title: Move build/test gates to claimable Task Server gate steps
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Implement the approved GateAttempt target from the Remote Gate Target Architecture Dossier. Add the bounded Task Server GateSubject/GateAttempt/lease/report lifecycle, capability-based Agent Host gate claims, exact-SHA materialization, typed timeout and infrastructure retry behavior, central visibility, and Orchestrator Engine dispatch. Migrate post-build-test-gate to the new path and prove throughput and restart/failure parity. Do not tear down the SSH bridge in this card; keep AGT-2262 blocked until the cutover acceptance conditions are met.
